name: Glint field
details: Holo foil flecks, energy icons and the odd swirl across the whole frame, each flashing as a wandering light passes.
usage: glint at 50,50 area 100,100 density high loop

name: Glint around a creature
details: A cloud of foil glints that follows a creature wherever it goes.
usage: glint around WHO density high loop

name: Glint hug
details: Glints only in a halo round the creature's own outline, following its shape frame by frame.
usage: glint hug WHO [grow 2.2] density 900 drift up loop

name: Thermal
details: The creature as a thermal camera sees it: body heat, breath, a heartbeat and warm air rising.

name: Thermal, rainbow
details: The same heat read through a rainbow palette, here on a water creature's cooler body.
usage: fx thermal on WHO type=water palette=rainbow

name: Hit ring
details: A ring of light with spikes bursting out of it and a four-point star, split warm and cool like a lens.

name: Thunder
details: A sky bolt: the scene dims, forked arcs run out to the edges and knock out everything within reach.

name: Smoke puff
details: A round cel-shaded puff of smoke that billows and clears.

name: Smoke bank
details: A low wall of smoke rolling across the ground.

name: Smoke dust
details: A burst of dust thrown up from the ground.

name: Smoke ring
details: A ring of smoke spreading out flat along the ground.

name: Smoke wisp
details: A thin wisp curling up and drifting away.
usage: smoke wisp at X,Y [dir DEG] loop

name: Smoke trail
details: A trail of smoke left across the frame, as behind something fast.

name: Smoke blast
details: An explosion's cloud thrown out from one point.

name: Mushroom cloud
details: A column of smoke rising into a mushroom cap.

name: Smoke flower
details: Smoke opening out in petals from the centre.

name: Smoke swirl
details: A spiral of smoke turning round its centre.

name: Ground dust
details: Pixel grains kicked up by rings rippling out from an impact, falling back under a fine haze.
usage: dust at X,Y [size S] [rings N] [colour grey|sand|dark]

name: Colour grade
details: The whole world pushed towards a time of day or a mood, easing from one grade to the next.

name: Holo foil
details: A holo trading card's foil laid over the frame: sparkles, swirls drawing themselves in, a prismatic shimmer and a glare.

name: Spotlight
details: The frame dimmed but for a soft pool of light on one creature, with a faint beam coming straight down.

name: Flash
details: The screen flashing and fading back.

name: Camera shake
details: The camera knocked about by a blow, then settling.

name: Rain
details: Rain falling across a top-down map.

name: Snow
details: Snow drifting down across a top-down map.

name: Spreading fire
details: A tile catches fire and it spreads through the grass, leaving the ground scorched.

name: Lava crater
details: A lava crater opening under the fight, its cracks branching out and pulsing.

name: Cave-in
details: Rocks and boulders fall and pile up with dust and shake, then become part of the map.

name: Electric bubble
details: A crackling bubble of light round a creature, glowing on the floor under it.

name: Shield
details: A lit bubble raised round a creature.

name: Twinkle
details: Four-point glints twinkling round a creature.

name: Chain lightning
details: A bolt jumping from one creature to the next, each struck as it lands, every link staying lit.
usage: chain WHO through A B C [hop 0.4s]

name: Electric bolt
details: A zigzag bolt flown across the map from one creature to another, with its impact.
usage: attack WHO MOVE on TARGET as electric

name: Fire stream
details: A stream of fire flown from one creature to another.
usage: attack WHO MOVE on TARGET as fire

name: Water jet
details: A jet of water flown from one creature to another.
usage: attack WHO MOVE on TARGET as water

name: Ice beam
details: A beam of ice flown from one creature to another.
usage: attack WHO MOVE on TARGET as ice

name: Psychic rings
details: Rings of psychic light flown from one creature to another.
usage: attack WHO MOVE on TARGET as psychic

name: Hyper beam
details: The big beam, lit through the glow buffer: a white-hot core in a soft halo.
usage: attack WHO MOVE on TARGET as hyper

name: Shadow orb
details: An orb of dark energy flown from one creature to another.
usage: attack WHO MOVE on TARGET as ghost

name: Leaf storm
details: Leaves flown from one creature to another.
usage: attack WHO MOVE on TARGET as grass

name: Dash
details: A fast run with afterimages, speed lines and dust behind it.

name: Leap
details: An arc jump: a crouch, a squash on take-off, a stretch in the air and dust on landing.

name: Ball pop
details: A ball thrown in an arc bursts open in a flash and rays of light, and the creature grows out of it.
usage: throw ball from POS to POS trail / pop ball into WHO

name: Recall beam
details: A red beam takes a creature back: it turns red and shrinks to nothing.

name: Change
details: A white glow, and the creature is something else.

name: Floor cracks
details: Cracks running out across a 3D stage's floor from one point, and staying.

name: Shockwave
details: A wall of light and dust rolling out across the floor, rippling it as it goes.

name: Charge-up
details: Gathering a blow: an aura, light drawn into the fist, rocks lifting off the floor, the ground trembling harder.

name: Release
details: The blow let go: a lunge, a hit-stop, a white-out impact frame, a shockwave and the target blasted away.

name: Charge clash
details: Two creatures sprint at each other and meet: streaks of air, a hit-stop, a flash, sparks and both knocked back.

name: Storm sky
details: Storm clouds rolling over a darkened stadium.

name: Evolution
details: Rises, goes dark, flickers between the two forms in a holo swirl, shrinks into light and grows out as the new form.

name: Sparkle, on the walker
details: The walker's own sparkle in palette inks: flecks catching the light one at a time and a star on the brightest.
usage: fx sparkle on WHO count=N / pw_world::sparkle::Sparkles::round

name: Hit ring, on the walker
details: The hit ring in integers and four inks, as the walker's battle draws it.

name: Caustic water
details: The bright net of light that water throws on the bed under it, two webs drifting across each other.

name: Flash, on the walker
details: The battle flash as the board draws it: a fill stepping down through a 4x4 ordered dither.
